name: Chinese Chicken Fried Rice
desc: Cold rice stir-fried with chicken, shredded egg, onion, and soy sauce.

source.title: Chicken Fried Rice
source.evidence: Identical ingredient list and amounts (1 egg, 1 tbsp each water, butter and oil, 2 cups cold rice, 1 cup cooked chicken, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp pepper) and the same flat-omelet method.

steps: Beat the egg with the water. Melt the butter in a large skillet or wok over medium-low heat, add the egg, and cook without stirring until set, 1 to 2 minutes. Slide it out, roll it up, and cut into thin shreds.
Heat the oil in the same skillet over medium-high heat. Add the onion and cook, stirring, until soft, about 3 minutes.
Add the cold rice and spread it out. Let it sizzle undisturbed for 1 minute, then add the soy sauce, pepper, and chicken and stir-fry until the rice is hot through, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the shredded egg and serve hot.
tips: Use rice cooked a day ahead and chilled; freshly cooked rice turns mushy in the pan.
